name: Prestige - Sewer Cluster Rollout Plan 2026-08-01
body:
> Plan · Prestige · 2026-08-01

# Summary
This plan publishes a 7-post sewer cluster on a stagger of about one post every 2 days. Each post goes up as noindex/nofollow and stays out of the sitemap and blog index until all 7 are live, then everything flips to indexable at once. The goal is that Google never crawls a cross-link to a post that does not exist yet. The hard prerequisite was the NameHero account being over its disk quota (17 GB, writes failing). The baseline audit later confirmed that blocker resolved on 2026-08-12.

# Drip order (all created 2026-08-01, status "Pending, not yet published" in the CSV)
| Day | Post | Focus keyword | Scheduled |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | [Prestige - Blog - Sewer Backup](lib:brain-prestige-blog-sewer-backup) (pillar) | sewer backup | 2026-08-01 |
| 2 | [Prestige - Blog - Sewage Smell After Rain](lib:brain-prestige-blog-sewage-smell-after-rain) | sewage smell after rain | 2026-08-03 |
| 4 | [Prestige - Blog - Sewer Smell in House](lib:brain-prestige-blog-sewer-smell-in-house) (hub) | sewer smell in house | 2026-08-05 |
| 6 | [Prestige - Blog - Backwater Valve](lib:brain-prestige-blog-backwater-valve) | backwater valve | 2026-08-07 |
| 8 | [Prestige - Blog - Trenchless Sewer Repair](lib:brain-prestige-blog-trenchless-sewer-repair) | trenchless sewer repair | 2026-08-09 |
| 10 | [Prestige - Blog - Old Sewer Pipes](lib:brain-prestige-blog-old-sewer-pipes) | cast iron sewer pipe | 2026-08-11 |
| 12 | [Prestige - Blog - Sewer Line Maintenance](lib:brain-prestige-blog-sewer-line-maintenance) (links to nearly all, so last) | sewer line maintenance | 2026-08-13 |

# Per-upload steps
Add the noindex,nofollow meta, set datePublished and the visible date to the real upload date, and upload `index.html` with its 2 images. Do not touch sitemap.xml or blog/index.html yet.

# Final "go-index" step
1. Remove noindex from all 7.
2. Add 7 sitemap entries with lastmod.
3. Add 7 cards to the blog index.
4. Wire inbound links from older posts and the pillar's backflow preventer link.
5. Fix datePublished if dates changed.
6. Resubmit the sitemap and request indexing in GSC.

# Gated for Scott (keep out of all bodies)
Pricing and cost figures, free estimate or inspection language, warranty or guarantee statements, and the emergency rate structure.

# Status
No publish confirmation exists in this folder. Treat the drip as pending unless a later EOD says otherwise (see [EOD Reports Index](lib:brain-eod-reports-index)).
